name: Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972

complianceTasks.title: Designate Title IX Coordinator
complianceTasks.description: Designate at least one employee as Title IX Coordinator responsible for coordination of compliance efforts

complianceTasks.title: Publicize Coordinator Contact Information
complianceTasks.description: Publish name, office address, email, and phone number of Title IX Coordinator

complianceTasks.title: Notify All Persons of Coordinator
complianceTasks.description: Notify applicants, students, employees, and unions of coordinator designation

complianceTasks.title: Adopt Non-Discrimination Policy
complianceTasks.description: Adopt and publish policy stating institution does not discriminate on basis of sex

complianceTasks.title: Publish Policy in Catalog
complianceTasks.description: Include non-discrimination statement in course catalogs and bulletins

complianceTasks.title: Publish Policy on Website
complianceTasks.description: Display non-discrimination policy prominently on institution website

complianceTasks.title: Include Policy in Handbooks
complianceTasks.description: Include non-discrimination statement in student and employee handbooks

complianceTasks.title: Adopt Grievance Procedures
complianceTasks.description: Adopt and publish grievance procedures for resolving complaints of sex discrimination

complianceTasks.title: Provide Prompt and Equitable Resolution
complianceTasks.description: Ensure grievance procedures provide for prompt and equitable resolution

complianceTasks.title: Include Notice of Grievance Process
complianceTasks.description: Notify students and employees of grievance procedures

complianceTasks.title: Train Title IX Coordinator
complianceTasks.description: Provide training on definition of sexual harassment, scope of institution program

complianceTasks.title: Train Investigators
complianceTasks.description: Train investigators on issues of relevance and how to conduct investigation

complianceTasks.title: Train Decision-Makers
complianceTasks.description: Train decision-makers on issues of relevance of questions and evidence

complianceTasks.title: Train Informal Resolution Facilitators
complianceTasks.description: Train any person who facilitates informal resolution process

complianceTasks.title: Publish Training Materials
complianceTasks.description: Make training materials publicly available on website

complianceTasks.title: Offer Supportive Measures
complianceTasks.description: Offer supportive measures to complainant upon receiving report

complianceTasks.title: Provide Written Explanation of Options
complianceTasks.description: Explain to complainant process for filing formal complaint

complianceTasks.title: Maintain Records for Seven Years
complianceTasks.description: Maintain records of investigations, appeals, and informal resolutions for 7 years

complianceTasks.title: Document Supportive Measures
complianceTasks.description: Create records documenting basis for supportive measures provided

complianceTasks.title: Retain Training Records
complianceTasks.description: Maintain all materials used to train Title IX personnel for 7 years

complianceTasks.title: Provide Equal Athletic Opportunity
complianceTasks.description: Provide equal athletic opportunity for members of both sexes

complianceTasks.title: Assess Athletic Program Equity
complianceTasks.description: Evaluate whether athletic interests and abilities are equally accommodated

complianceTasks.title: Review Athletic Financial Assistance
complianceTasks.description: Ensure athletic scholarships are proportionate to participation

complianceTasks.title: Audit Athletic Equipment and Supplies
complianceTasks.description: Review equivalence of athletic equipment, uniforms, and supplies

complianceTasks.title: Review Coaching and Support Staff
complianceTasks.description: Ensure equivalence in coaching, tutoring, and other support

complianceTasks.title: Prohibit Admissions Discrimination
complianceTasks.description: Do not discriminate on basis of sex in admissions

complianceTasks.title: Review Recruitment Materials
complianceTasks.description: Ensure recruitment materials do not discriminate

complianceTasks.title: Accommodate Pregnant Students
complianceTasks.description: Treat pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions as temporary disability

complianceTasks.title: Provide Lactation Space
complianceTasks.description: Provide reasonable break time and private space for lactation

complianceTasks.title: Allow Medical Leave
complianceTasks.description: Allow medical leave for pregnancy and childbirth

complianceTasks.title: Prohibit Employment Discrimination
complianceTasks.description: Do not discriminate on basis of sex in employment

complianceTasks.title: Review Hiring Practices
complianceTasks.description: Ensure hiring practices do not discriminate

complianceTasks.title: Review Compensation Equity
complianceTasks.description: Ensure equal pay for equal work regardless of sex

complianceTasks.title: Review Promotion Practices
complianceTasks.description: Ensure promotion and tenure decisions are non-discriminatory

complianceTasks.title: Prohibit Retaliation
complianceTasks.description: Prohibit retaliation against anyone who reports or participates in Title IX process

complianceTasks.title: Monitor for Retaliation
complianceTasks.description: Actively monitor for and address any retaliatory conduct

complianceTasks.title: Conduct Climate Survey
complianceTasks.description: Periodically assess campus climate regarding sexual harassment

complianceTasks.title: Provide Prevention Education
complianceTasks.description: Offer education programs on sexual harassment prevention

complianceTasks.title: Review Policies Annually
complianceTasks.description: Conduct annual review of Title IX policies and procedures

complianceTasks.title: Track and Report Data
complianceTasks.description: Maintain and analyze data on Title IX complaints and resolutions
